profile.name: Sarif Mubdi Jantika
profile.title: Data Analyst | Continuous Learner
profile.bio: Senior data analyst with 12+ years across accounting, finance and cross-functional operations, hands-on across the modern data stack (Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, SQL, Python). At Evermos I work with data engineers and cross-functional teams to build and improve our data infrastructure: dbt models and pipelines, a central warehouse, data conventions and a trusted single source of truth (SSOT) for finance. I replace manual, error-prone processes with automation (journals, invoicing, audit data) and care about standards that make data reliable and teams faster. I also lead small-scale data projects and have mentored 100+ aspiring analysts, so I know how to help people grow.
profile.bioExtended: My extensive background across accounting and finance enables me to bridge business complexity with analytics engineering — transforming raw transactional datasets into trusted, audit-ready data models and high-impact automated workflows.

projects.title: Tokped E-Commerce Pricing & Promo Analytics
projects.description: An end-to-end e-commerce pricing and promotion intelligence engine analyzing 20,976 cleaned Tokopedia listings across 14 categories. Engineered with DuckDB, dbt Core, and Python with a Medallion architecture (staging, intermediate, mart) and statistical hypothesis testing (H1–H6). Uncovers empirical discount saturation points (1–10% discount doubles high-velocity products while >20% erodes margins), models Official Store pricing power (+55.4% aggregate premium, 2.25x sales volume), and delivers an interactive Unit Economics & Margin Simulator web dashboard.
projects.sneakPeekLabel: Sneak Peek of Pricing & Promo Analytics

projects.title: Biz-In-Sight Intelligence Engine
projects.description: An end-to-end e-commerce decision intelligence engine that discovers high-demand product niches, uncovers unmet consumer complaints via Indonesian NLP sentiment analysis, and simulates sourcing unit economics before capital deployment. Features automated multi-source ingestion (Playwright, Shopee, Tokopedia, TikTok Creative Center, Google Trends), a Supabase PostgreSQL warehouse, and the proprietary Winning Product Score (WPS) engine powering an interactive Next.js 16 executive dashboard with an interactive Sourcing & Pricing Simulator.
projects.sneakPeekLabel: Sneak Peek of Sourcing Intelligence Engine

projects.title: Tableau Vizzes
projects.description: Data is only as good as the decisions it inspires. This showcase features a collection of Tableau dashboards where I’ve turned complex datasets—from behavioral modeling to global performance—into clear, interactive stories. By blending rigorous data analysis with custom UI/UX, I build tools that don’t just show numbers; they make navigating deep insights feel effortless and intuitive.

projects.title: Customer Profiling Analysis
projects.description: Leveraging Astro's customer dataset, I engineered a behavioral segmentation model using unsupervised machine learning. By utilizing RFM (Recency, Frequency, Monetary) analysis as the feature engineering backbone, I implemented K-Means clustering to identify distinct customer personas. The project concludes with data-driven recommendations and strategic interventions tailored to the specific behavioral patterns uncovered during the analysis.

projects.title: Demand Planning Analysis
projects.description: Tasked with demand planning analysis for Astro, I developed a system to optimize inventory procurement and warehouse management through data-driven forecasting. After evaluating several methodologies—including Moving Averages, Decomposition, and Trend Analysis—I identified Holt-Winters Exponential Smoothing as the most reliable model based on its superior MAPE performance. The final solution is delivered via an interactive Google Sheets dashboard, transforming these projections into actionable insights for streamlined inventory planning.

projects.title: Google Sheet Convention Script
projects.description: Developed a validation system using Google Apps Script to prevent data entry errors in shared spreadsheets. Each sheet includes a 'Schema' tab defining expected data types per column. Invalid inputs trigger automatic error notifications and are immediately removed, significantly improving data quality and ETL pipeline reliability.
projects.sneakPeekLabel: Sneak Peek of Schema Validation Scenario

projects.title: Automated Weather Report Pipeline
projects.description: This automated weather intelligence pipeline serves as a blueprint for my production-ready data workflows, bridging the gap between raw external data and actionable insights. Orchestrated by Airflow, the system fetches real-time data from the Open-Meteo API via Python, processing it through a local ETL engine that utilizes Pandas to transform raw CSVs into refined datasets. The final output is automatically pushed to the Google Sheets API, enabling seamless integration with Looker Studio to deliver a ready-to-use dashboard.
projects.sneakPeekLabel: Sneak Peek of Airflow DAG Pipeline

projects.title: OCR Expense Tracker
projects.description: Built a lightweight web-based expense tracker deployed on Vercel, where users upload bill images through a simple interface and instantly convert them into structured transaction logs in Google Sheets. The app processes images using OCR (Google Cloud Vision), extracts key details like date, merchant and total and stores both parsed data or raw images for traceability. Designed for low-volume, free-tier usage, it focuses on fast input, clean automation and minimal infrastructure while keeping the system reliable and easy to maintain.

projects.title: AI Qualification Screener
projects.description: Built an automated end-to-end recruitment screener and WhatsApp notification system. Orchestrated via n8n, this workflow processes PDF CV applications, runs match evaluations using OpenAI's gpt-4o-mini, logs scores to Airtable CRM, and routes candidates. Applicants with a match score >= 75 receive an automated WhatsApp interview invite via Fonnte and trigger internal recruiter alerts via Telegram, while other profiles receive a polite rejection email. The system cuts manual screening time by 85% and speeds up candidate outreach to less than two minutes.
